before: Edge-IIoTset is distributed through IEEE DataPort [1], CICIoT2023 through the University of New Brunswick (UNB) [7], and TON_IoT through the University of New South Wales (UNSW) [8, 30]. The reproducibility evidence is organized into four groups (R1–R4) as a separate supporting-data package for the journal submission and reviewer-access system. The package comprises code, frozen configurations, SHA256 manifests, split and target identifiers, saved model probabilities and labels, explanation arrays, raw replay-time and memory logs, and derived external-label mappings. Its archive index identifies individual files by relative path and checksum; the saved-results entry point verifies selected observations without refitting estimators or deserializing trained models. The supplementary material summarizes the protocols and key evidence in Sections S1–S5 and Tables S1–S5, with the detailed observations indexed in R1–R4. Full third-party datasets are not redistributed; reproducing raw-PCAP extraction requires access to the provider datasets, the applicable permissions, and the documented processing environment.
